hadith:
Divine Will (Al-Qadar) - Narrated Ibn `Umar:

The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade vowing and said, "In fact, vowing does not prevent anything, but it makes a miser to spend his property."
message: The account of the People of the Elephant reminds us that Allah is the Protector of His servants. Trust in Him, and remember that making a vow does not prevent what happens.
name:
Al Waliyy - الْوَلِيُّ - The Protector

Al Waliyy describes Allah's protection and support of His servants. Quran 7:196 speaks of His protecting the righteous, and 42:28 pairs this name with Al Hameed. Al Waali is a distinct but related Arabic form; their meanings need not be forced into wholly separate categories.
verse:
Al-Fil - The Elephant - 105:3-5

For He sent against them flocks of birds, that pelted them with stones of baked clay, leaving them like chewed up straw.
